entries.2d3b2a107514743e: A cloud service provided by the company and its consolidated subsidiary Kea Bijinesu Sapōto Shisutemu Co., Ltd. to welfare equipment rental providers. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.44febdeb3ffd3ca8: A company that provides wholesale rental and wholesale sales of welfare equipment to welfare equipment rental providers, and also offers living support services for the elderly.
entries.7561c140564f03ba: Designated home-care service providers (welfare equipment rental providers)
entries.ce8aaa1126967ded: This is the core service the company focuses on. Positioned between welfare equipment manufacturers and providers, it operates rental wholesale, which rents out rental-eligible items covered by long-term care insurance to providers nationwide that have concluded basic rental agreements, and sales wholesale, which sells purchase-eligible items to care facilities and users through providers. Welfare equipment returned after use is cleaned, disinfected, inspected and repaired under maintenance services provided by the company, and is then made available for rental again. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥30,113 million.
entries.e0e7de6e74ea5de4: It is the group's only segment. Centered on welfare equipment services, it operates in combination with elderly living support services. Consolidated net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥34,929 million, and as of March 31, 2026, there were 99 operating bases and 1,062 consolidated employees.
